notes: Read SKILL.md and references/sast-tools.md in full. The skill covers static application security testing of the user's source code with Semgrep (CLI, custom rules, CI), CodeQL (workflow and a sample query), SonarQube (docker-compose, scanner config, quality gates), Bandit, ESLint security plugin and Brakeman, plus a jq-based CI gate script.

Medium: following it has the agent install scanners with pip, brew, npm (--save-dev, modifying package.json) and gem, and run them over the local codebase writing report files; `semgrep --config auto`/registry rulesets download rules from the Semgrep registry. Acceptable because these are standard, read-only analyses of the user's own code and the installs are well-known security tools the user asked to adopt.

Users should know: CI examples reference SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN/SONAR_TOKEN only via GitHub secrets; the SonarQube compose file uses default sonar/sonar passwords suitable only for local trials; the SonarSource actions are pinned to @master rather than a version. Related Skills (SKILL.md:417-419) link to sibling skills ../dast-scanning/, ../dependency-scanning/, ../../../devops/ci-cd/github-actions/ as optional reading only.
